design.authoritative: n=1 uses jax.jit(saved_core.rollout) in float32, same history and input casting as historical evaluation; n=2/4 use the same midpoint/SO3 equations with mechanical subdivision only
design.bound: 90 authoritative predictions plus 90 local traces; replay permits exactly the same 180 calls once. Synthetic analytic tests are separate. No fits, gradients, simulator or controller calls.
design.filter: At each original interval, evaluate applied command from the same interval-start value and analytic exponential at substep start/midpoint; end with original full-interval exponential. Preserve exact original start applied value at t=0. History and hidden advance once per original 0.01 s interval from observation-start features.
design.trace: One separate observation-boundary-forced local trace per authoritative trajectory. Force only physical state at each original observation boundary, reconstruct original causal filter/history/hidden, integrate inner stages freely. Record local next state and residual against authoritative next state. This avoids recursive amplification of instrumentation-only roundoff.

measurements.contributions: At start, each growth threshold and last finite stages, report six-vector norms and quadratic share of sum of component norms; descriptive, not causal ablation.
measurements.convergence: Report all 1/2/4 finite flags, crossing/failure times, finite common-prefix discrepancies, endpoint and prefix physical residuals. No choosing a best n, no forced aggregate win count, no missing failures.
measurements.growth: First crossing of velocity and angular-rate norms 10,100,1000,1000000 in respective physical units, plus physical error vs saved truth. Thresholds describe growth, not application adequacy.
measurements.head: At both head stages: current/scaled sampled/scaled quadratic features, tanh preactivation/activation, separate linear/quadratic/bias/nonlinear contributions and scaled acceleration. Original summation association retained. Record history/hidden and analytic filter states.
measurements.rotation: Midpoint/end rotation increment vectors, float32 squared norms and resulting matrices to distinguish downstream Rodrigues overflow
measurements.state: Every boundary and substep physical state, velocity/rate norm, rotation orthogonality/determinant, first nonfinite interval; all failures retained

next_decision: Select one prospective learner or integrator intervention only after diagnosis; freeze any subsequent fit as a separate iteration.

alterations: numeric query change rejected against frozen external anchor
numeric model change rejected against frozen external anchor
numeric trace change rejected against bound replay receipt even if a local seal is repaired
summary metric change rejected by independent reducer
fixtures: filter endpoint and one memory/history update across subdivision
quadratic feature versus rotation norm overflow
proof.inputs: Verify every roster anchor and query/model/prediction hash before inference. Bind committed diagnostic source, unchanged inference functions, Python/JAX/runtime, protocol and roster.
proof.replay: Re-execute 90 authoritative and 90 local trace calls with saved inputs, compare raw arrays equal_nan and independently recompute summaries without refitting.

qualification.completion: All 90 combinations attempted once with durable call records, all raw traces saved (including nonfinite), sealed provenance, independent NumPy reduction, deterministic replay, actual input/model/trace/summary alteration rejection. No public promotion. A failed equivalence gate yields bounded inconclusive attribution rather than post-hoc tolerance changes.
qualification.historical_replay: All 30 n=1 predictions must match saved dtype/shape and array_equal(equal_nan=True); mismatches make original-recurrence attribution inconclusive and are not repaired by changing dtype/tolerance/model.
qualification.local_trace: Record exact equality, finite masks, maximum finite local discrepancy, and allclose rtol=0.0001 atol=0.00001. A trace is numerically qualified only if finite masks match and all finite next-state elements meet this fixed tolerance. Unqualified traces are explicitly descriptive and cannot establish original recurrence attribution.
qualification.science_interpretation: Persistent runaway under 1/2/4 supports recurrence pathology but does not prove continuous-time blowup. Improvement under refinement indicates numerical sensitivity, not a qualified remedy. Component magnitude alone does not establish causality. State/action coverage is not inferred from command coordinate ranges.
